title: Surjective coefficient restriction preserves constructible cohomology
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], A and B commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] in the independent coefficient universe and f:A -> B a surjective ring map. Let K belong to the actual constant-B pro-etale derived category [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. For every integer q, if H^q(K) is affine-locally constructible over B then H^q(Res_f K) is affine-locally constructible over A [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. Restriction is the exact existing dres of the constant sheaf map induced by f. No boundedness of K or Noetherianity of X is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09AJ, definition-constructible, and Tag 09BR, lemma-compare-truncations-constructible, scalar restriction in the induction.

proof.text: Naturality of the constant-ring sheafification unit gives a sectionwise identity isomorphism between fixed scalars after intrinsic scalar restriction and sheafCompose with ModuleCat.restrictScalars. This is the proved private comparison restrictionFixed.

ModuleCat.restrictScalars preserves colimits, hence the left Kan extension computing inverse image. Mathlib leftKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves and sheafComposeNatIso give restrictionPullback. Slice restriction commutes definitionally with composition, and constantCommuteCompose identifies the restricted constant sheaf with the constant sheaf of the restricted module.

Retain each affine open, its finite stratification, its constructibility witnesses and covering sieves. For every constant B-module model M, restrict its finitely generated top submodule along the surjective algebra map using Submodule.FG.restrictScalars_of_surjective. Noetherianity of A gives Module.finitePresentation_of_finite. Compose the comparisons from the first two steps with the restricted local trivialization. This proves the private sheaf-level restrictionConstructible.

Install the standard derived localizations and exactness of scalar restriction from siteRestrictScalars_exact. The inverse of Mathlib mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso identifies the desired cohomology sheaf with restriction of H^q(K). Apply restrictionConstructible to this isomorphism and the hypothesis hK.

theorem coefficientSurjectiveRestriction_constructible (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A B : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (K : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X B) (q : ℤ)
    (hK : IsCoefficientAffineLocallyConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf.{u, v} X B
      ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K)) :
    IsCoefficientAffineLocallyConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf.{u, v} X A
      ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj
        ((dres (adicFiniteConstantMap f
          (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X))).obj K))
